stem: A pH reading changes sharply on one older probe, while a second verified meter remains stable. What should happen before changing system inputs?
choices: Verify the suspect probe with appropriate standards and comparison checks
Change the system immediately to match the older probe
Average both meters without checking either one
Discard the second meter because it disagrees
rationale: Unexpected readings should be verified before they drive operational changes. Instrument drift or fouling can create false problems.
